findings.description: Email cap SQL path not tested: both test_email_cap.py tests pass sessionmaker=None, bypassing the actual SQL upsert. The boundary condition (90th send allowed, 91st blocked), atomicity of INSERT … ON CONFLICT, and the commit are untested. Add a real-DB test that pre-inserts count=DAILY_RESEND_LIMIT and asserts _check_and_increment returns False.

uv version not pinned in CI: version: 'latest' in astral-sh/setup-uv@v4 can install a uv incompatible with the frozen uv.lock, causing uv sync --frozen to fail or produce a different environment. Pin to a specific version string.

/health/deep failure returns opaque 500: no try/except means a Neon autosuspend timeout is indistinguishable from an application error. Add a SQLAlchemyError catch returning {status: error, db: unreachable} with 503.

Content-Security-Policy absent from security headers middleware. For a JSON-only API the risk is minimal, but adding Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none' satisfies the OWASP baseline with one line.
